02-09-1883 is 2 September 1883.  
27 weeks = 189 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 194 days.  
September 2 minus 194 days:  
September has 2 days back to Sep 1 → 1 day used, 193 left.  
August 31 days → 193-31=162 left, July 31 → 162-31=131, June 30 → 131-30=101, May 31 → 101-31=70, April 30 → 70-30=40, March 31 → 40-31=9, February 28 (1883 not leap) → 9-28 = -19 → go into January.  
January 31 days: 31-19=12 → January 12, 1883.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1883-01-12
